thresholds.method: Tuning set only (80 frames, 80 bursts, every burst frame asked with the production call). Policy: escalate if P(person/vehicle) >= escalate_above in any frame of the burst; skip only if max P(animal) over the burst < skip_below; small (Nova Lite) if the frame's P(animal) >= small_above; otherwise large (Nova Pro, Decider unsure). Difficulty is still asked but not used. skip_below: highest 0.01 step at which no tuning animal burst has max P(animal) below it (lowest animal-burst max 0.417; the per-frame rule gives 0.37). small_above: lowest 0.01 step from which tuning frames at or above every higher step are at least 95% animal (the midpoint-of-gap rule would give 0.77). escalate_above: unchanged from v1.

v1.method: Tuning set only. Wording: highest AUC (escalation ties broken by the widest gap between classes). skip_below: highest 0.01 grid value with zero tuning animals scoring below it (miss budget 0; lowest animal score 0.376). small_above: midpoint of the gap between the highest-scoring empty frame Decider called clear (0.347) and the lowest-scoring clear animal frame above it (0.888). escalate_above: midpoint of the gap between the highest non-person/vehicle frame (0.332) and the lowest person/vehicle frame (0.741), labels audited by eye where CCT marks people as empty.
